snippet.title: Chicken Run: Eggstraction | Announce Trailer | US | ESRB
snippet.description:
The chickens are back!

Chicken Run: Eggstraction follows Frizzle on her first mission since Dawn of the Nugget to rescue chickens from twisted farms and villainous foes!

You’ll sneak, solve puzzles, and rally your feathery crew to freedom between hilarious cut scenes packed with chaos and fun.

1–2 player co-op

Stealth + strategy + laughs = eggstra fun

Coming soon to Xbox, PlayStation, Nintendo Switch, and Steam!

#ChickenRunEggstraction
